main.title: Resident Evil 2
main.summary: Resident Evil 2 is a 2019 survival horror game developed and published by Capcom.

cards.heading: Return to Raccoon City
cards.text: Resident Evil 2 is a 2019 survival horror game developed and published by Capcom. A remake of the 1998 game Resident Evil 2, it was released for PlayStation 4, Windows, and Xbox One in January 2019 and for Amazon Luna, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S in June 2022, with a cloud version for Nintendo Switch released the following November. Versions for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS were released in December 2024, and a version for Nintendo Switch 2 released in October of 2026. The player controls rookie police officer Leon S. Kennedy and college student Claire Redfield as they attempt to escape Raccoon City during a viral outbreak that turns ordinary citizens into zombies and other monsters.

cards.heading: Rebuilding horror with the RE Engine
cards.text: Capcom considered remaking Resident Evil 2 following the release of the remake of the first Resident Evil in 2002, but the producer, Shinji Mikami, did not want to divert development from Resident Evil 4 (2005). Capcom announced the Resident Evil 2 remake in 2015 and released the first trailer and gameplay footage at E3 2018. It was built on the RE Engine, which was also used for Resident Evil 7: Biohazard.

cards.heading: Reception and success
cards.text: Resident Evil 2 received acclaim for its presentation, gameplay and faithfulness to the original. It won the Golden Joystick Award for Game of the Year and was nominated for the Game Award for Game of the Year. It is the highest-selling Resident Evil game, having sold more than 20 million copies as of September 2026. It was followed by remakes of Resident Evil 3 in 2020 and Resident Evil 4 in 2023.

main.title: Tetris 99
main.subtitle: A familiar well among ninety-eight rivals
main.summary: Tetris 99 is Arika's online puzzle game, released for Nintendo Switch Online members on 13 February 2019.

cards.heading: A familiar well among ninety-eight rivals
cards.text: Tetris 99 is Arika's online puzzle game, released for Nintendo Switch Online members on 13 February 2019. Ninety-nine people play Tetris simultaneously, each trying to remain after every other board has overflowed. Rotating and arranging tetrominoes still clears complete horizontal lines, but successful combinations also send garbage rows to opponents. The player's own well occupies the centre of a screen filled with smaller rival boards, making a solitary-looking puzzle part of a contest whose pressure can arrive from several directions.

cards.heading: Choose where the cleared lines go
cards.text: Targeting adds another decision to placing the falling pieces. The player can select an individual opponent or use automatic strategies that seek vulnerable players, attack rivals with badges or retaliate against attackers. Clearing lines can cancel incoming garbage before it enters the well. A useful move may therefore provide breathing room instead of immediately damaging someone else. Tetrises, T-spins and consecutive clears reward the ability to build an attack while preserving space for the next unexpected delivery.

cards.heading: Survive long enough to become the target
cards.text: Knocking out an opponent awards badge pieces and transfers the defeated player's collected badges, increasing the strength of later attacks. A successful competitor gradually becomes more dangerous and more tempting to target. The pace also rises as fewer players remain, turning careful early construction into a test of rapid decisions. Later additions included offline modes and team battles. The original online format gives every cleared row two meanings: space recovered on the player's board and pressure potentially passed to another person.
